title: Pen Sketching is a Confidence Builder
content: Pen Sketches byÉdouard Detaille, 1848-1912Sketching directly from life in pen with no pencil lay-in is a good thing to do once in a while. It builds confidence and sharpens your accuracy.Because pen sketches preserve every touch—every boldness and hesitancy—they're like an indelible record of thought itself.
